I take a tissue and turn on the water. Alice: "Or should we wash this first?" Tasha: "Just clean it." I add dishwashing liquid. Tasha: "Isn't there detergent here?" Tasha: "We've got dish soap, right?" Alice: "There's a lot of grease though." I wipe my hands. "So, wash this first, right?" I ask. "I'm going to wash the pot," I say, and I pick up the pot and glance at Alice, then at Tasha. "Okay, then I'll throw this... Where should I throw this? The stuff inside," I ask. Tasha: "Which one?" Alice: "What about this trash can" I turn to look at Alice. "Give me a bag," I say. "Come on, a bag, a bag, get a bag," I call.

[DAY2 21:06:30 - DAY2 21:06:59]
I get ready to wash the dishes and look behind me, turning my head to scan. "This isn't enough," I say. "How about we take some downstairs to eat?" I ask. I start washing the dishes. "Let's bring another one," I say. "Take the bowl downstairs to wash, okay?" I ask, and I point at the bowl. "This is enough here," I say. Shure: "Come on, come on, come on, come on." I pick up a plastic bag, prepare to move it, and set it down. Alice: "There's still some here." Choiszt: "Uh, wait a sec, don't throw that yet, take this first." I continue washing the dishes, using a wet wipe to slowly scrub the bowl clean. Katrina: "What's cheerbaby? When they're doing chores, you just cheer for them. Babycheer. Baby can also dance." I look for a place to put the clean bowls and place the cleaned bowl on the table.

[DAY2 21:03:01 - DAY2 21:03:30]
Tasha: "Oh my god, wow." I toss it back into the trash bag and clean the sink. Tasha: "The boss is actually doing the hardest work." "For sure." I glance at my right hand, turn on the faucet, and start washing my hands. Tasha: "Hey, the edge of this bowl is so dirty." "Oh man, this oil." I try to wash my hands until they're clean but can't get the thick oil off by hand. "Such a thick layer." Then Tasha hands me a tissue. "This." "First, you, you, you come here and be useful." I'm cleaning up and cleaning my hands, rubbing them back and forth.
